title: Warehouses
description: Manage the locations that hold your stock.

help.title: About warehouses
help.overview: The places where you keep stock. Stock, transfers, counts and tills all belong to a warehouse. Name and code are required; the address decides the VAT of till sales.

sections.title: Each warehouse
items: Make default makes this your main warehouse; checkout takes stock from it first.
Only active warehouses can sell stock or be given to tills. A till's only warehouse can't be deactivated or deleted.
A warehouse that still holds stock or reservations can't be deleted: move the stock or write it off first.
Inventory shows its stock; Stock movements shows its history.
